title: Mystery Shoulder-Fired Surface-To-Air Missile Appears In Russian Service
summary: An unusual shoulder-fired surface-to-air missile (MANPADS) has reportedly appeared in Russian service. title: Pakistan Navy’s First Hangor-class Submarine Performs First Live Firing in North Arabian Sea
summary: The Pakistan Navy's first Hangor-class submarine, PNS Hangor, successfully conducted its maiden live weapon firing in the North Arabian Sea on September 26, 2026. This event marks a significant demonstration of the newly inducted submarine's operational readiness and combat capability. The successful firing confirms the vessel's integration into the fleet.

title: US, UK test SM-6, other missiles on SINKEX target frigate
summary: The United States and United Kingdom conducted a joint SINKEX (Sink Exercise) to test various munitions against a target frigate. The exercise involved the testing of SM-6 missiles and other weapons. A Navy official confirmed that the final blow to sink the vessel was delivered by an Mk 48 Advanced Capability Torpedo.
